No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you compare Lodhi-era tomb and mosque forms through material details.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Orientation at main garden approach
  • Bara Gumbad mosque and decorative surfaces
  • Shish Gumbad external fabric
  • Draw and compare elevations

How the time is spent

  1. Orientation at main garden approach 20 min

  2. Bara Gumbad mosque and decorative surfaces 30 min

  3. Shish Gumbad external fabric 40 min

  4. Draw and compare elevations 20 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Compare Lodhi-era tomb and mosque forms through their material details.
  • Describe the decorative surfaces of the Bara Gumbad mosque and the external fabric of Shish Gumbad.
  • Draw and compare the elevations of the two buildings.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
